_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'LESSONS LEARNED REGISTER' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-05.07.

f01_ID.label: ID
f01_ID.guidance: Unique identifier for the lesson learned (e.g., LLR-01).

f02_Category.label: Category
f02_Category.guidance: Knowledge area or project phase (e.g., Technical, Procurement, Schedule).

f03_Trigger.label: Trigger
f03_Trigger.guidance: The triggering event, root cause, or situation encountered.

f04_Lesson.label: Lesson
f04_Lesson.guidance: Detailed description of what worked well or what should be done differently.

f05_Responsible_Party.label: Responsible Party
f05_Responsible_Party.guidance: Person or role assigned to document or disseminate the lesson.

f06_Identifier_Submitter.label: Identifier/Submitter
f06_Identifier_Submitter.guidance: Name or team identifying the lesson.

f07_Next_Implementation_Opportunity_Date.label: Next Implementation Opportunity & Date
f07_Next_Implementation_Opportunity_Date.guidance: Future milestone, project, or date where this lesson will be applied.

f08_Organizational_Impact_Y_N.label: Organizational Impact (Y/N)
f08_Organizational_Impact_Y_N.guidance: Whether this lesson impacts enterprise processes, standards, or assets.

f09_Comments.label: Comments
f09_Comments.guidance: Additional reflections, training recommendations, or references.
